quote: You keep hiding your quiet tears, pretending that everything is completely fine. But your tired eyes give away the heavy burden you carry. People only see the smile you wear to keep them from asking. They never notice the pieces of your soul slowly fading into the dark. Stop pretending that you are unbreakable when your spirit is quietly shattering inside. True healing only begins the moment you finally allow yourself to break completely down.
